held.why: HELD (brief V: approach and wilderness differ). The candidate is the pass-free object on wa_three_o_clock_rock_total_soul, but its rules line does not fit Exfoliation Dome. (1) Approach: the official Eight-Mile Trail 654.02 page (updated 2026-04-17) says the trail serves Three O'Clock Rock on Jumbo Mountain, reached 8 mi up FR 2060; it never mentions Exfoliation Dome. The dome is reached cross-country from pullouts on the LEFT fork of FR 2060 about 5 mi in, not by that trail. (2) Wilderness: the USFS EDW wilderness layer puts the Witch Doctor Wall and Blueberry Hill/Proxima Wall points OUTSIDE any wilderness (Boulder River Wilderness is the nearest, roughly 1.5-2.5 km away), while the Three O'Clock Rock point is inside it. The USFS ownership and ranger-district layers confirm Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF, Darrington Ranger District. (3) Pass: the Region 6 list of day-use fee sites (updated 2026-09-15) has no Darrington or FR 2060 site, so no official page backs the stored Northwest Forest Pass line. The stored LEGACY object is wrong either way: it names Glacier Peak Wilderness and a 12-person wilderness cap, a Mount Rainier NP fee line and a Mountain Loop Highway pass. Owner options: (a) a land_manager-only object, {"land_manager": "Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Darrington Ranger District)"}, which every official page read supports; or (b) access null. Road: no MBS alert names FR 2060 (only the Mountain Loop Hwy Bedal-Barlow Pass winter closure and washouts on FR 26/2660/2640/2642); absence of an alert is not proof the road is open, so road status stays unconfirmed.

The row should keep grade 5.11b (the free grade Mountain Project lists as the headline); the 5.10b A1 option (aid the bolted 5.11 crux) is an alternative, matching how Ancient Melodies treats its A0 option. Not renamed (owner call; the id is name-derived). FA shape defect: stored fa '2003, Matt Perkins and friends' puts the year inside the names string (matches MP's line; not reformatted). Rack per MP: gear to 3 in, singles from small stoppers/tiny TCUs up, doubles 3/4-1 in help on P7; crux well bolted; rappel the route with two ropes, trending right (south) on P3-5 saves one rap.
